build_export_case_file: build a PyTorch export case file by running gen_example.py with a case name argument
create_case_template: create a new export case template with example inputs and tags using the TEMPLATE string
generate_case_module: generate a PyTorch export case module in the examples directory by passing the case name as a CLI argument
run_gen_example_cli: run gen_example.py as a CLI tool to scaffold a new export case Python file
test_export_case_scaffold: test the export case scaffolding by generating a case file and verifying the template output
